plan.title: Block mixed service and material PR purchase

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions screen, the required entry point for PR sourcing.
Ensure the PR list is on the Open tab where Purchase Items is available.
Select a PR with two line items as the closest available representation of selecting the service and material lines together.
Hover the Purchase Items control to expose its disabled-state tooltip.
